Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/twisted/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/twisted/synths/, not this file.
Every controller is a row of the manual's MIDI Implementation, sent as the controller it prints on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The VIBRATO block prints its two rows as "Arp Rate" (CC 48) and "Arp Depth" (CC 13), the names of the ARP block's; they are laid out as printed, in the VIBRATO group, which says what they are.
Renamed where the manual's own block shows the name: Op4 Total Level: printed "Op3 Total Level" under OPERATOR 4, whose other rows are all Op4's; OPERATOR 3 has its own Op3 Total Level (CC 16).

Left out, rows whose controller is not one controller number: LFO1 Depth (When Active in setup) (Velocity), LFO2 Depth (When Active in setup) (1 (mod wheel)), LFO3 Depth (When Active in setup) (Aftertouch).

coverage.inboundControllers: the controllers the page marks In/Out are sent back by the instrument
